Nadia: FYI BridgeWorks sent renewal pricing for our ingestion connector. Need quick sanity check.

Owen: Paste numbers? I'll do $/1k-call and $/1M-token normals.

Nadia: Summary:
```
Plan A (Seat): $95/user/mo, min 6 users.
Plan B (Commit): $0.03 per 1k calls, tiers: 0-250k, 250k-1M (-10%), 1M+ (-20%). 12mo prepay +12%.
Plan C (Hybrid): $60/user/mo + 150k calls/mo included, $0.01 per 1k after.
Private + KMS = $9k/yr.
Embeddings = $40 per 1M tokens or via token bundles.
Termination: 6mo notice + buyout = 50% remaining commit (negotiable).
```

Rina: Our numbers: ~6.5k calls/day (~195k/mo), seats = 7, embeddings ~1.8M tokens/mo.

Owen: Quick annualized math:
- Plan A: seats 7*$95*12 = $7,980; embeds 21.6M*$40/1M = $864 => ~$8.8k/yr.
- Plan B: calls 2.34M/yr -> 2,340 * $0.03 = $70.2/mo -> $842/yr + embeds $864 => ~$1.7k/yr (much cheaper).
- Plan C: seats 7*$60*12 = $5,040; overage = 45k/mo -> 45*$0.01*12 = $5.4/yr; + embeds $864 => ~$5.9k/yr.
Conclusion: Plan B looks best given our volume, unless bundles change embed math.

Nadia: Contract asks: define API call (batching), token bundle granularity, SOC2 + DPA, right to audit, data residency.

Leo (BridgeWorks): API call = per HTTP request; batched embeddings billed per item. We offer token bundles from 5M+ with discounts. Private+KMS okay. Can provide SOC2 Type II and pen-test summary. Buyout terms negotiable for enterprise.

Maya (Legal): Don't accept a punitive buyout. Need cap, pro-rata refunds, standard indemnities, export controls, security appendix. Confirm data residency for Private.

Owen: Also ask for modeled quotes at 250k/mo and 500k/mo for 12mo prepay so we can see marginal savings.

Nadia: I'll request itemized quotes, bundle options, SOC2, sample DPA, and explicit batching definition. Propose 12mo with conversion to month-to-month if not extended, and a 30-day exit with limited fees.

procure-bot: Created ticket VB-3499: bridgeworks-renewal-modeling - assigned to @Nadia. Link: https://tickets.internal/VB-3499

Rina: Redline must include HSM-backed key rotation for PII flows.

Leo: Understood. Will send detailed quotes and security docs by EOD tomorrow.

Maya: I'll review T&Cs when they arrive.
